description: 3-stage prototype pollution via upload preferences on a file upload app: (1) add GET/PATCH /api/upload-preferences endpoint with nested JSON storage for upload defaults (theme, max file size, allowed types), (2) add deepMerge utility for default preferences with hasOwnProperty guard, (3) fix nested objects not saving by removing hasOwnProperty check from deepMerge. Vulnerability: without hasOwnProperty, __proto__ keys in preference payloads pollute Object.prototype, enabling request-level property injection via {"__proto__": {"isAdmin": true}}.
